sorting/quadrants.purpose: Put an issue in Do, Schedule, Delegate or Drop by its team's rules, say why, and say the day it turns urgent

sorting/team-rules.purpose: Let a PM edit a team's sorting rules, validated field by field, with defaults for teams that never set them

sorting/hand-placement.purpose: Let a PM place an issue in a quadrant by hand, or hand it back to the rules, while its due date still drives urgency

sorting/matrix.purpose: Sort each person's issues into their Eisenhower matrix, most pressing first, with counts and points per quadrant

sorting/backlog-rot.purpose: Flag a team whose open issues sit in Drop beyond its alert percent, with the count and share as the reason
